what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Venezuela in Trinidad and Tobago: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 20886 Venezuelan asylum seekers in Trinidad and Tobago, 1.8% of all asylum seekers from Venezuela.
Refugees from Venezuela, a separate group, live mostly in Spain, Brazil, the United States and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Venezuela, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2015 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 25367, at the end of 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Trinidad and Tobago.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Trinidad and Tobago only.
